_comment: The single config file for this app. Everything that changes when you point the repo at a new dataset / business domain lives here. Three things deliberately do NOT: the sqlite file, the system prompt, and the kickstart questions -- those are content, not configuration. Secrets live in .env. There is no author/personal identity anywhere in this app: it is a product showcase, not a portfolio.

checks._comment: Vocabulary from datasets this repo USED to serve. `mise run check` fails if any of these words survive in code. When you swap datasets, move the outgoing domain's distinctive nouns into this list -- that is what makes a forgotten file impossible to miss.
